name: com.chinadoccheck/mcp
title: ChinaDocCheck — 16-Country China Hague Apostille, USDOS Jurisdiction & 180-Day Validity Engine
description: Verify 16-country China Hague Apostille rules, 180-day validity & USDOS jurisdiction.

tools.name: route_country_apostille_and_legalization_authority
tools.description: Match applicant issuing country and certificate category against 16 national authentication profiles to identify federal vs provincial Apostille agencies, statutory fees, and SAFEA compliance notes.

countryQuery.description: ISO 2-letter code (US, GB, JP, KR, CA, AU, PK, IN, ES, DE, RU, FR, ZA, AE, SG, PH), slug, country name, or "all".

documentTypeId.description: Specific China visa document category to route to the competent issuing authority.

tools.name: calculate_180day_document_validity_radar
tools.description: Measure elapsed calendar days since police check issuance, deduct DHL courier and SAFEA bureau review buffers, and classify net safe filing windows into safe, warning, critical, or expired.

issueDate.description: Original print/issuance date printed on the police background check in YYYY-MM-DD format.

asOfDate.description: Optional reference date in YYYY-MM-DD format to evaluate deadline status against (defaults to current UTC date).

shippingBufferDays.description: Estimated calendar days for international DHL/FedEx transit and domestic translation (defaults to 10).

safeaReviewBufferDays.description: Estimated days needed for sponsoring Chinese HR and SAFEA bureau preliminary acceptance (defaults to 15).

tools.name: check_us_federal_vs_state_apostille_jurisdiction
tools.description: Prevent automatic Chinese work permit rejection by matching U.S. FBI checks, university diplomas, TEFL certificates, or state police clearances to USDOS or 10 state Secretaries of State with RON rules.

docCategory.description: United States credential type requiring Apostille authentication for China Z-visa filing.

stateCode.description: Two-letter U.S. state code where the university or state agency is registered (ignored for federal FBI checks).

notaryMethod.description: Notarization workflow: traditional wet-ink in-person notary vs Remote Online Notarization (RON).

tools.name: inspect_country_deep_legalization_dossier
tools.description: Retrieve comprehensive stage-by-stage authentication timelines, fingerprint requirements, Tier-1 municipal enforcement nuances, and printable filing checklists from deep jurisdiction dossiers.

includeCityNuances.description: Include Shanghai, Beijing, Shenzhen, and Tier-2 SAFEA enforcement strictness directives.

tools.name: audit_safea_translation_and_remote_notary_compliance
tools.description: Verify whether a translation package satisfies PRC mainland corporate dual-seal mandates and evaluate Shanghai, Beijing, GBA, and Tier-2 city acceptance of Remote Online Notarization (RON).

translatorCountry.description: Where the Chinese translator operates: registered mainland agency, foreign bureau, or applicant self-translation.

hasTranslationSpecialSeal.description: Whether every translated page bears the dedicated PSB-registered Translation Special Seal (翻译专用章).

hasBusinessLicenseCopy.description: Whether a corporate-stamped copy of the Chinese agency Business License is attached.

targetCity.description: Municipal SAFEA bureau reviewing the foreign documents and potential e-Apostille/RON seal.

tools.name: diagnose_zvisa_document_rejection_risks
tools.description: Screen an applicant filing configuration against documented high-frequency SAFEA RFE triggers including mismatched state/federal apostilles, expired 6-month police checks, and sealed envelope breaches.

countryCode.description: Applicant home document country code (e.g., "US", "JP", "KR", "GB", "AE") or omit to list all top statutory traps.

submittedFbiToStateSos.description: True if a U.S. FBI Identity History Summary was routed to a State Secretary of State instead of USDOS.

openedSealedPoliceEnvelope.description: True if a confidential sealed police certificate envelope (e.g., Japan Keishicho) was opened prior to Apostille.

koreaCheckPurpose.description: For South Korean KNPA checks: whether issued specifically for Foreign Entry/Stay vs domestic employment.

tools.name: retrieve_multilingual_police_clearance_guide
tools.description: Fetch complete native-language SAFEA criminal record and Apostille instructions, timelines, RFE case studies, and FAQs in Japanese, Korean, German, French, Russian, or Spanish.

locale.description: Target applicant language guide (ja=Japan, ko=Korea, de=Germany, fr=France, ru=Russia, es=Spain, or "all").

tools.name: generate_printable_visa_dossier_checklist
tools.description: Assemble an ordered end-to-end document authentication checklist tailored by home country and visa role (Standard Z-Visa, ESL Teacher, S1/S2 Dependent, or Corporate POA).

countryQuery.description: Home issuing country ISO code or name (e.g., "US", "GB", "CA", "AU", "IN", "PH").

applicantRole.description: Visa category determining required diplomas, TEFL, civil marriage/birth certificates, or corporate POAs.
